description: Search the index for documents matching a query. The query is run through the default text pipeline (lower-casing, punctuation removal, whitespace tokenization, and Porter stemming), and any document whose indexed text contains a resulting term is returned. A term that appears in several documents returns all of them. A query with no matches returns an empty result. Each search emits one line 'search=<comma-separated entries sorted by document identifier>' where each entry is '<documentId>:<matchTerm>' and matchTerm is the processed (stemmed) query term that matched.
